size_guide.intro: To ensure a comfortable, bespoke fit for your 950 silver or 18K gold jewel, consult our conversion chart and artisanal measurement methods.
size_guide.method1_desc: Take a ring that fits you comfortably and place it over a millimeter ruler. Measure the inside distance in a straight line from inner edge to inner edge (excluding metal rim).
size_guide.method2_desc: Wrap a strip of paper or string around the base of your finger. Mark where the ends meet with a pen and measure the length in millimeters against a ruler.
size_guide.adjustable_note_desc: Our open-architecture creations (such as the Two-Headed Snake Ring) feature high-purity 950 silver ductile form, allowing gentle millimeter adaptation between sizes (e.g. Size 18 comfortably fits 17 to 19).

hero.subtitle: Handcrafted jewelry fusing the millenary heritage of the Andes with contemporary, symbolic design.

story.title: Inspired by Ancestral Strength and Rebirth
story.body1: Born in the sacred heart of Cuzco, Andean Morphia honors the eternal strength of the Andes and the transformative beauty of the blue Morpho butterfly. Each design bridges ancient goldsmith heritage with contemporary aesthetic sensibility.
story.body2: More than designing jewelry in gold and silver, we create symbols of personal transformation that accompany each person on their journey toward authenticity, freedom, and inner awakening.
story.quote: “The Morpho butterfly as an emblem of personal growth.”

about.hero_subtitle: The sacred union between Andean origins and conscious evolution.
about.essence_p1: Andean Morphia Jewelry was born in Cuzco, Peru, inspired by the ancestral strength of the Andes and the meaning of transformation and rebirth embodied by the blue Morpho butterfly.
about.essence_p2: We represent the union of origin and evolution, tradition and conscious change. More than crafting gold and silver pieces, we create symbols of transformation that accompany personal journeys of growth, freedom, and authentic beauty.
about.mission_p: To create gold and silver jewelry that expresses identity, transformation, and rebirth, fusing Cuzco's Andean heritage with contemporary design, to accompany each person in their process of personal evolution.
about.vision_p: To be a benchmark jewelry brand in Cuzco and nationwide for its authentic identity, symbolic design, and ability to transform jewelry into meaningful pieces, connecting tradition, art, and inner transformation.
about.packaging_desc: Packaging is tailored to the precious material (Gold or Silver), upholding the ethereal, refined aesthetic of our atelier:
about.packaging_item1_desc: Pastel sky blue suede and velvet envelopes with custom inner jewelry inserts, paired with sheer white organza gift bags.
about.packaging_item2_desc: Personalized thank-you notes and curated care manuals tailored separately for Silver and Gold jewelry.
about.packaging_quote: “Pastel sky blue velvet envelopes and sheer white organza pouches”
